svg.text: Gateway — ESP32 DevKit V1 30-pin — full wiring
Coloured labels 5V / 3.3V / GND = the breadboard power rails. No pull-up resistor needed.
Pin 1 = leftmost ribbon pin when the keys face you.
Pin 8 → D4 on the other side (purple label).
Power rails: ESP32 VIN pin → top + rail (5V) · ESP32 3V3 pin → bottom + rail (3.3V) · both GND pins → the − rails (join the two − rails).
Every label with the same name is the same rail. Power the ESP32 from a 5 V USB adapter (VIN then carries 5 V). The on-board blue LED lights with the green one (both on D2).
RC522: 3.3 V ONLY — never connect it to 5 V. RST goes to the 3.3 V rail. Tamper reed on RX2: no resistor (built-in pull-up).
LEDs: 220–330 Ω each (2.2 kΩ works, dimmer); long leg = anode, towards the ESP32. D2 and D15 are boot pins: an LED to GND is safe; never add a pull-up there.
Wire by the labels printed on YOUR board — some clones put the pins in a different order.
